blocks.text: WE KNOW WHO TRAINED YOU, AND HOW YOU GOT IN.
YOU HAVE TWO CHOICES. FEDERAL PRISON, FOR A VERY LONG TIME. OR YOU KEEP SENDING YOUR MESSAGES... BUT WE WRITE THEM.
HOW DID THE FBI FIND HIM SO FAST? NO ONE HAS EVER SAID. HE SUSPECTED A SIMPLE LETTER: THE ONE HE HAD WRITTEN TO AN UNCLE IN AMERICA TO ASK FOR HIS BIRTH CERTIFICATE.
